benchmark.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x00009A60) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
benchmark.note: Native diffuse option only; no visual QA routes. ABBA natural shadow cache / forced refresh, identical camera and wind clocks within blocks. Four plants at .75, 1280x720. Thirty RAF warmups and 24 serial asynchronous GPU queries per block. CPU is render submission; GPU excludes query waiting. Not FPS, loading time, or an original-vs-diffuse quality comparison.
